600902.describe: Uses a Machine Gun to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.15</color>x DMG. After combat, applies <color=#F74848>1</color> random buff to all allies involved in this attack, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

600908.name: Rei's Sacrifice
600908.describe: Uses a Large Shield to attack a target, dealing <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> equal to <color=#F74848>50%</color> of the current Arm's Max HP plus <color=#F74848>20%</color> of its current HP. Upon hit, destroys the current Arm.
